name: Wookey Cheddar
desc: A cloth-bound cheddar matured in the steady chill of Wookey Hole. Sharp, crumbly and slightly mineral. Restores 170 HP.

name: Hyena Tooth
desc: A brown, worn tooth from a spotted hyena of the last Ice Age, the sort that once denned in the Mendips. A museum would want it. A jeweller would want it more, for the wrong reasons.
